# PayTheory Lab

This is the LLM-optimized documentation for the PayTheory Lab GraphQL API.
For human-readable documentation, visit: https://docs.paytheory.com

## Docs

- [API Overview](https://docs.paytheory.com/llm-docs/lab/index.md): Quick reference with all operation signatures - authorizations, createAuthorization, createWalletAuthorization, createCapture, createVoidForAuthorization, barcode, createBarcode, disputes, …
- [Authorization](https://docs.paytheory.com/llm-docs/lab/authorization.md) - authorizations, createAuthorization, createWalletAuthorization, createCapture, createVoidForAuthorization
- [Barcode](https://docs.paytheory.com/llm-docs/lab/barcode.md) - barcode, createBarcode
- [Disputes](https://docs.paytheory.com/llm-docs/lab/disputes.md) - disputes
- [Invoice](https://docs.paytheory.com/llm-docs/lab/invoice.md) - invoices, createInvoice, updateInvoice, deleteInvoice, createInvoiceEmail, createOfflineTransaction
- [Merchant](https://docs.paytheory.com/llm-docs/lab/merchant.md) - merchant, merchants, createMerchant, updateFeeMatrix, updateMerchantSettings
- [Metadata](https://docs.paytheory.com/llm-docs/lab/metadata.md) - updateMetadata, deleteMetadata
- [Payment Links](https://docs.paytheory.com/llm-docs/lab/payment-links.md) - paymentLinks, createPaymentLink, updatePaymentLink
- [Payment Method Token](https://docs.paytheory.com/llm-docs/lab/payment-method-token.md) - paymentMethodTokens, createPaymentMethod, updatePaymentMethodToDisabled, validatePaymentMethodOwnership
- [Payor](https://docs.paytheory.com/llm-docs/lab/payor.md) - payors, createPayor, updatePayor
- [Recurring Payment](https://docs.paytheory.com/llm-docs/lab/recurring-payment.md) - recurringPayments, createRecurringPayment, updateRecurringPayment, cancelRecurringPayment, missedRecurringPaymentData, createRetryForFailedRecurringPayment
- [Settlement](https://docs.paytheory.com/llm-docs/lab/settlement.md) - settlements, availableFundsBalance, fundingTransfers, instruction, cancelSettlementInstruction, createSettlementInstruction
- [Split](https://docs.paytheory.com/llm-docs/lab/split.md) - splits
- [Transaction](https://docs.paytheory.com/llm-docs/lab/transaction.md) - transactions, createTransaction, createWalletTransaction, createReversal, serviceFee, createReceiptEmail, updateTransactionInReview
- [Users](https://docs.paytheory.com/llm-docs/lab/users.md) - users, createUser, deleteUser
- [Webhooks](https://docs.paytheory.com/llm-docs/lab/webhooks.md) - createWebhook, webhooks, updateWebhook, deleteWebhook, webhookEvents
- [Sandbox](https://docs.paytheory.com/llm-docs/lab/sandbox.md) - createBarcodePaymentSandbox, createBatchCapture, createSandboxAchReturn, createSandboxDispute, createSandboxSettlement, prepareSandboxSettlementBatch, updateSandboxDisputeStatus
- [Deprecated](https://docs.paytheory.com/llm-docs/lab/deprecated.md) - createOneTimePayment, createRefund, serviceFeeAmount
